pvDesc: Privacy Policy for the Composition Grid browser extension. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.
pvBrand: Composition Grid: Rule of Thirds, Golden Ratio & More
pvOverviewP: Composition Grid is a browser extension for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox that overlays composition grids (Rule of Thirds, Golden Ratio, Fibonacci Spiral, Golden Triangle, Fifths, and Center Crosshair) on images and video across the web. We are committed to protecting your privacy.
pvDataP1: We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.
pvDataLi1: Stores your settings (grid types, colors, sizes, language, site filter lists) locally using the browser's storage.sync API
pvDataLi2: Reads the active tab's URL locally to show/hide the context menu based on your site filter settings
pvDataLi7: Does not send data to any external servers
pvPermStorage: Save your grid settings and site filter lists locally
pvPermContext: Add a right-click menu option to toggle the grid on images
pvPermTabs: Read the active tab's URL to hide the context menu on sites you have blocked or not allowed
pvPermAllUrls: Overlay grids on images across all websites
pvThirdP: This extension does not use any third-party services, APIs, or analytics tools.
pvChangesP: If we update this privacy policy, the changes will be posted in this document with an updated date.
